Overview

Corporate Compliance, Tracked Year-Round

Once a company or LLP is registered, compliance doesn't stop — annual returns, financial statement filings, director KYC and event-based filings (share transfers, director changes) all carry their own deadlines and penalties for delay.

We track your entire ROC compliance calendar so filings happen on time, every time, without you needing to monitor deadlines yourself.

What We Handle

Complete ROC & Company Law Compliance

🏗️

Company Incorporation

End-to-end incorporation filing with the Registrar of Companies, including name approval and SPICe+ filing.

📅

Annual Filing

Annual return (MGT-7) and financial statement (AOC-4) filings prepared and submitted within statutory deadlines.

🪪

Director KYC

Annual DIR-3 KYC filing for all directors to keep DINs active and avoid deactivation.

📈

Share Capital Changes

Filings for allotment, transfer, or alteration of share capital, kept aligned with your statutory registers.

🔚

Company Closure

Guidance and filing support for voluntary strike-off or closure of a company that's no longer operating.

🤝

LLP Compliance

Annual return (Form 11) and statement of accounts (Form 8) filings for Limited Liability Partnerships.

Who Needs This

Every Registered Company or LLP

  • Private Limited and Public Limited Companies with pending annual filings
  • LLPs that haven't filed Form 11 or Form 8 for the current year
  • Companies with director changes or share transfers to record
  • Businesses whose DIN has lapsed due to missed KYC filing
  • Dormant companies considering formal closure

What's at Stake

Why This Can't Be Left Until Later

  • Avoid additional government fees that accumulate for delayed filings
  • Keep your company or LLP in "active" status, not marked as default
  • Maintain a clean compliance record for future funding or due diligence
  • Prevent DIN deactivation that can block other filings

Our Process

How We Manage Your ROC Compliance

1. Compliance Calendar Setup

We map every filing your entity is required to make and when it's due.

2. Document Preparation

We prepare the required forms and resolutions ahead of each deadline.

3. Filing

Forms are filed with the ROC, and acknowledgements are shared with you.

4. Ongoing Tracking

We continue tracking event-based filings (director changes, share transfers) as they arise.
